description: Recorded drums and percussion from CC0 libraries (Versilian VCSL, Karoryfer Big Rusty Drums and Swirly Drums): big toms, kicks, snares, marching and concert bass drums, timpani, frame drums, cymbals, hats, swells, gongs, hand percussion and metal impacts, trimmed, mixed from the upstream mics, levelled (-1.1 dBTP) and level-matched per round-robin group. 44.1 kHz 24-bit WAV. Three round-robin kits: kit/trailer-recorded@1, kit/orchestral-recorded@1, kit/acoustic-recorded@1. Optional: install with `voyager-daw library install drums-recorded-cc0`.

kits.name: Trailer (recorded)
kits.description: Cinematic/trailer percussion from CC0 recordings: marching bass drum on the kick, 22/18/15-inch toms with felt mallets (the closest free thing to taiko), rimshot snare, slapstick crack, claves and woodblock ticks, a large frame drum, clash cymbals, a cymbal swell, low timpani and a concert bass drum. Round robins on every pad.

kits.name: Orchestral percussion (recorded)
kits.description: Orchestral percussion from CC0 recordings (VCSL): concert bass drum, concert snare, timpani low/mid/high on the toms, clash cymbals, suspended cymbal, a suspended-cymbal swell, tambourine, triangle, woodblock, slapstick and tam-tam.

kits.name: Acoustic kit (recorded)
kits.description: A full acoustic kit from CC0 recordings (Karoryfer Big Rusty Drums): 24-inch kick, 14-inch snare with side stick, 14-inch hats (closed, pedal, open), 14/15/18-inch toms with sticks, 17-inch crash, 22-inch ride, group claps and tambourine (VCSL). Round robins on every pad.
